claim_boundary: internal held-out-from-final-retrain evidence; not historically untouched and not external
failure_policy: Fail closed; do not replace, tune, or rerun the frozen test operating point.
primary_hypothesis: On the 9,900 pairs held out from the final retraining, certified RB-SR has mean free-ROI RMSE strictly below its matched Ridge anchor, target-relative new flip no greater than Ridge, and a projected-fold-set subset certificate rate of exactly 1.0.
scope: Retrospective internal identity-disjoint final-rerun holdout. These identities and some pair outcomes were available during earlier project development, so this is not a historically untouched or external confirmation. They are excluded from every input to the final retraining and the frozen holdout is not reopened until all models are frozen.

statistical_analysis_plan.degenerate_rule: all-zero or non-finite Wilcoxon is p=1 and never significant
statistical_analysis_plan.primary_family: certified RB-SR versus matched Ridge across the six frozen metrics
statistical_analysis_plan.primary_tests: source-identity paired two-sided Wilcoxon with Holm correction over six metrics
statistical_analysis_plan.secondary_direct_comparison: certified RB-SR versus LAMM across the same six metrics
statistical_analysis_plan.secondary_family: all reportable methods versus matched Ridge across the same six metrics
statistical_analysis_plan.uncertainty: 10,000 source-identity and target-identity cluster bootstrap replicates
